topic: Indian Lower Paleolithic Sites and Discoverers/Regions
questionText:
Match the famous Indian Lower Paleolithic sites in List-I with their geographical regions or archaeologists in List-II:

List I:
(A) Attirampakkam (Tamil Nadu)
(B) Bhimbetka (Madhya Pradesh)
(C) Isampur (Karnataka)
(D) Soan Valley (Potwar Plateau, Pakistan)

List II:
(I) Excavated by V.S. Wakankar; deep stratigraphy with Acheulean to Mesolithic layers
(II) Discovered by H. de Terra and T.T. Paterson (1939); type-site of Soanian pebble culture
(III) K. Paddayya excavated a limestone quarry-cum-workshop Acheulean site in Hunsgi valley
(IV) Cosmogenic nuclide dating by Shanti Pappu pushed Acheulean antiquity in India to ~1.5 Ma

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-IV, B-I, C-III, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-IV, B-III, C-II, D-I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-I, B-IV, C-III, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-IV, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Attirampakkam has 1.5 Ma Acheulean (Pappu); Bhimbetka has Acheulean cave strata (Wakankar); Isampur is an Acheulean quarry (Paddayya); Soan is pebble tools (de Terra & Paterson).
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
